instructions: Replace template values with exercise-specific records. Add entries for every configuration used, including earlier versions or their Git commits. No credentials.

development_tools_and_models.notes: Antigravity IDE paired with Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) used for development assistance, code generation, and test creation.

plugins_and_extensions.notes: No external plugins or IDE extensions were required.

application_models_and_parameters.notes: llama-3.3-70b-versatile via Groq and gpt-4o-mini via OpenAI with temperature 0.0 and json_object response format. Offline cached responses in cached_responses/ for zero-credential deterministic replay.

skills.notes: No external skills installed; standard Antigravity IDE and Groq Llama 3.3 were used directly.

hooks_and_scripts.notes: No custom git hooks or background scripts.

prompts_and_rules.notes: System prompt enforcing strict unit quantities, forbidding packaging inference (box, pack), and returning structured JSON.

tool_and_mcp_settings.notes: Native OpenAI/Groq Tool Calling schema CATALOG_LOOKUP_TOOL integrated into _run_live_extraction. LLM calls lookup_catalog natively; local lookup_catalog_tool executes it; result fed back as tool role message before final JSON extraction.

permissions_and_environment_names.notes: Environment variables GROQ_API_KEY, GROQ_MODEL, OPENAI_API_KEY, OPENAI_MODEL.

configuration_records.name: Order Extractor System Prompt
configuration_records.purpose: Extract structured product mentions and quantities while strictly forbidding guessing box or pack unit counts.
configuration_records.used_during: Order intake extraction and exception detection

configuration_records.name: Groq / OpenAI LLM Configuration
configuration_records.purpose: JSON extraction with zero temperature and cached replay fallback.

configuration_records.name: CATALOG_LOOKUP_TOOL
configuration_records.purpose: Native OpenAI/Groq function schema enabling the LLM to call the local product catalog lookup tool during extraction. The model emits tool_calls with query arguments; _run_live_extraction executes lookup_catalog_tool locally and feeds results back as tool role messages before the final JSON is produced.
configuration_records.used_during: Live LLM extraction with native function calling
